text:
Maya: Quick flag 128px breakpoint is problematic for the catalog. Filters shrink and compare columns overflow. Thinking of swapping the left filter rail for a slim, sticky chip-strip above the table on medium widths. Thoughts?

Juan: I built a quick prototype: group headings become chips, chips scroll horizontally, rarely-used groups go in an overflow menu. GIF in Figma comment.

Kevin: Sounds promising. Concern: pin flow. If I pin a version from the table, will chips show that pin? Current behavior only updates the table column.

Maya: I'd like chips to reflect pin state so people can glance which versions are pinned without scanning columns.

Aria: Accessibility note: chips must be real buttons (or role=button) with aria-pressed and clear focus styles. If chips show pins, include sr-only text like "pinned" to help screen reader users.

Juan: Implementation: small svg pin visual but 24px target, keyboard via Enter/Space. Example: <button class="chip" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="v1.3, pinned">v1.3 <svg/></button>.

Kevin: Also Perf badges in rows are crowded (latency/cost/throughput). Idea: single compact "Perf" token with an inline expand control (chevron) to reveal metrics in-row. Tooltips alone are not sufficient for keyboard/screen readers.

Maya: Inline expand is fine but must not cause disruptive reflow. Perhaps expand a small panel attached to the row.

Aria: Requirements: perf toggle must use aria-expanded, expanded panel must be focusable and trap focus or provide an accessible close (Esc). Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any animation. Use aria-live polite when rows change (e.g., pin column inserted).

DesignBot: Accessibility checklist: chips have aria-pressed; perf toggle has aria-expanded; pinned-column insertions announced via live region; icons meet 4.5:1 contrast; interactive touch targets >=24px.

Juan: Dev note: inserting a pinned column can shift scroll and break selection. Plan to animate insertion and adjust scrollLeft to keep the previously visible content stable.

Maya: Two product choices: 1) pin auto-inserts a leftmost pinned column? 2) chips show pins persistently or only on hover? I prefer persistent small badge on chips.

Kevin: Agree on persistent badge. Also change microcopy: button label from "Pin" to "Pin version" to reduce ambiguity in other contexts.

Aria: Announce state changes only once: "Version v1.3 pinned to comparison." Do not duplicate announcements for chip + column.

Juan: I'll spike keyboard behaviors and post a short demo tomorrow. Estimate 3 dev days + a11y QA.

Maya: Thanks. I'll update Figma: sticky chip-strip, persistent chip pin badge with sr-only label, condensed Perf token with accessible expand, pinned-column animation, and live-region copy.

Kevin: UI nit: when Perf expands, show median latency large, a tiny sparkline, and a minimal table for cost. Keep colors semantic and high-contrast.

Aria: Add "Press Esc to close" hint and ensure focus returns to the perf toggle when closed.

DesignBot: Scheduling follow-up: accessibility pass Friday 9am PT.

Maya: I'll be there. Juan: ping when demo is up.

Juan: Will do, uploading later today.
